test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PRICK’ is written as 'QTLGP’, and ‘DOUBLE’ is written as 'EQXFQK'. How will ‘ACEGARD' be written in that language ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f852b8303d257d416137f3f5d105f0e82e025ca2e6e529be6387a1b8410aabe.png] 

The logic followed here is,

The letters is shifted by +1,+2,+3,+4,+5,+6.

‘PRICK’ is written as 'QTLGP’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41367633de6356d737faab091f92883cf95684d62b2d95e6fd2b125e95a3a4de.png] 

And, 

'DOUBLE’ is written as 'EQXFQK'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09cd9d4db321f3277fff53154254bb2127f03a9fc3e210a7b0cda344a57a9764.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/093ffc4129812507090484c51e53a6030820fd1e9deef82ea0e416ebc40b9ae0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"BEHKFXK"**.
